steps-past-revetment.quantity: Hayakawa's landing steps: px past the revetment rect's river face (east) and past its land face (west)
steps-past-revetment.method: harness.py steps(): the rect of the group declared data-id="landing-steps" against the data-kind="revetment" rect

doors-off-walls.quantity: data-kind="door" rects per sheet: wholly inside the building they open through, straddling its wall, or wholly outside it
doors-off-walls.method: harness.py doors(): each door against the built footprint it overlaps most (else the nearest); inside share > 0.99 INSIDE, < 0.01 OUTSIDE, else STRADDLE

torii-not-in-plan.quantity: data-kind="torii" groups per sheet drawn in plan (declaring the id="arch" rect) or as a silhouette
torii-not-in-plan.method: harness.py arches(): each torii group's markup searched for id="arch"

ochiba-aligned-gap.quantity: the widest aligned gap pack_audit reports on Ochiba, and the footprint standing between its pair
ochiba-aligned-gap.method: harness.py test_gaps(): aligned_gaps(parse_svg(sheet)), each gap's nearby structures listed
